main_text.head: Tenor Privilegij
SACRI ROMANI IMPERII, IN PARTIBUS RHENI, SUEVIÆ, ET IN JURE FRANCONICO PROVISORIS ET VICARII.
main_text.p: CAROLI LUDOVICI, Dei Gratia, Comitis Palatini Rheni, S.R. Imp. Archithesaurarij & Electoris, ejusdemque in partibus Rheni, Suevia, & in jure Franconico Provisoris ac Vicarij, Ducis Bavariæ, privilegio cautum est, ne quis libros, quos Academiæ Heidelbergensis Bibliopola & Typographus ADRIANUS WYNGAERDEN in Germania impressit, & adhuc impressurus, est, & præterea singulariter hic nominatos nimirum Burgersdicij Politicam, Castanæi distinctiones, Claubergij initiationem Philosophiæ, Ejusdem tractatum de cognitione Dei & nostri, Ejusdem paraphrasin in Cartesij Meditationes, denique Salmasij Epistolas, Riolani Enchiridion Ana-

page.notes: The title line "Tenor Privilegij" is set in roman type and the caps block is italic. The word "ADRIANUS" begins with a larger initial A and "WYNGAERDEN" is in small capitals. "Ana-" at the page foot is a hyphenated catchword-style break continuing onto the next page; kept as printed. Scan edges and show-through at the margins are left out.
